yt_title: Sea Otters Have The Densest Fur Of Any Animal #Shorts
desc: Sea otters have the thickest fur of any animal, with up to about one million hairs per square inch. It keeps them warm because they have no blubber. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: One million hairs in a single square inch! 🦦 Would you want fur like that? Follow for a fact every day. Send this to an otter fan. Comment YES or NO.

lines.text: Which animal has the thickest fur on Earth?
It is the sea otter, and it has no blubber.
Instead, up to one million hairs grow in every square inch.
A human head has only about one hundred thousand hairs in total.
That fur traps air to keep them warm in icy water. Thickest on Earth.
